item.title: Verbose beta 208
item.description:
Faster screens and fixes

  • Mac: choosing a look shows a short card while Verbose changes to it, and the change takes less time. On iPhone, this arrived in build 207.
  • Mac: screens appear at once when you switch to them, without sections fading in one by one, and Home's icons arrive drawn. They draw again when you point at them.
  • Mac: switching screens and opening a transcript do less work, so the app keeps up while something transcribes or plays.
  • Home's greeting and dates follow the clock while Verbose transcribes, plays, or dictates. On iPhone, You's dates do too.
  • Importing a damaged MP4 or M4A file no longer closes Verbose.
  • Mac: the thought pad's Send button names the app you switch to right away, and the pad stops checking once you close it.
  • Mac: on the You page, Cloud cleanup shows whether it's on and opens its own setting.
  • A long file that starts transcribing as Verbose opens keeps its saved progress, so if Verbose quits unexpectedly, the file picks up where it left off.
